name: delohome
description: Control the DeLorenzo house: lights, TVs, casting, and the devices in every room. Covers Philips Hue rooms and scenes, Z-Wave switches, casting to Chromecasts and the SHIELD, the Jellyfin library (DeLoFlix), and direct panel control of the bedroom Samsung, the two LG webOS TVs and the living room Fire TV. Use for turning lights on or off, setting a scene, playing or pausing something on a TV, switching a TV's input or power, pairing a new device, or editing the house map. Triggers: delohome, the house, turn on the lights, set a scene, put on, cast, what's playing, bedroom TV, Dommy's room, Ava's room, Hue, Z-Wave, Chromecast, Jellyfin, DeLoFlix, Samsung TV Plus, Fire TV, the Xbox, the PS5, home.yaml. Do NOT use for DeLoNET infrastructure, containers or host conventions (delonet-conventions), 33GOD platform work (33god-hub), or the Nanoleaf panels, which are driven by ~/.config/zshyzsh/scripts/nanoleaf.sh and are not part of DeLoHome.
